purpose: Machine-readable mapping of language-content quality, curriculum, child-safeguard, and privacy reference controls for Sinag ng Kaalaman.

scope.notice: This registry is an engineering and evidence map, not a declaration of DepEd accreditation, legal certification, or formal regulatory compliance.

controls.name: Filipino / Tagalog linguistic validity
controls.requirement: Canonical Filipino/Tagalog entries must be natural, contextually appropriate, orthographically defensible, and semantically aligned with the underlying concept.

controls.name: Hiligaynon linguistic validity
controls.requirement: Canonical Hiligaynon entries must be natural, contextually appropriate, and supported by institutional, academic, official-learning-resource, or corroborating usage evidence.

controls.name: Syllabification validity
controls.requirement: Stored syllable boundaries used in learner exercises must be reviewed and supported by language-appropriate orthographic or phonological evidence.

controls.name: Distractor and exercise suitability
controls.requirement: Distractors must be plausible enough to test understanding, clearly incorrect in context, non-punitive, culturally appropriate, and suitable for grade-school learners.

controls.name: Concept and category coverage
controls.requirement: The initial corpus should provide sufficient curriculum and category coverage; approximately 100 concepts is a planning target, not a quota.

controls.name: Grade-school definition and example suitability
controls.requirement: Definitions, examples, explanations, and sentences must be understandable and appropriate for grade-school learners while preserving linguistic meaning.

controls.name: Provenance and rights traceability
controls.requirement: Every imported, adapted, or externally evidenced content item must preserve source identifiers, license/conditions, review state, and whether redistribution is permitted.

controls.name: Child-safe learning presentation
controls.requirement: Learner content and feedback must avoid abusive, humiliating, coercive, exploitative, discriminatory, or age-inappropriate presentation.

controls.name: Privacy-minimized learner data
controls.requirement: Collect and retain only learner information required for local personalization and progress, with local-first storage and explicit export/import/reset controls.
